items.title: Large-scale fire spread in a spacecraft module: flight results
items.excerpt: Flame spread over the sample was faster than ground tests at the same airflow.

items.title: Droplet burning and extinction in microgravity
items.excerpt: Droplets extinguished at a diameter that depended on oxygen concentration.

items.title: Solid fuel flammability boundaries at low flow
items.excerpt: Spread was sustained at lower oxygen levels in microgravity than in normal gravity.

items.title: Gas jet diffusion flame behavior under varied flow
items.excerpt: Blow-off velocity fell as pressure was reduced.

items.title: Smoke particle size from overheated spacecraft materials
items.excerpt: Median particle diameter was larger than typical ground-based smoke detector test aerosols.
